{{Update |title1 = End of Summer Update |image1 = FZWG6bjXgAAK8 Y.jpg |release_date = 5 August 2022 (v1.3.1) |minor_updates = v1.3.1a (6 August 2022)
v1.3.1b (8 August 2022) |feed_title = 'End of Summer' Season |previous_update = [[v1.3.0|Polluted Wasteland II Update]] |next_update = [[v1.3.2]] }} __TOC__ ==Description== '''v1.3.1''' is the forty-first update to be released on Tower Defense Simulator, on the 5th of August 2022. This update was also given the name '''End of Summer Update''', as it added the [[End of Summer Season]]. This version encompassed three updates, the main v1.3.1 update (released 5 August 2022) and two minor updates, the v1.3.1a (released 6 August 2022) and v1.3.1b (released 8 August 2022). ==Additions== *[[End of Summer Season#Season Pass|End of Summer Season]] **Rewards: ***Rank 1 - {{Color|EndOfSummer|Beach}} [[Scout]] & [[Golden Scout]] ***Rank 2 - {{Color|EndOfSummer|Beach}} [[Militant]] ***Rank 3 - {{Color|EndOfSummer|Barbecue}} [[Pyromancer]] & [[Golden Pyromancer]] ***Rank 4 - {{Color|EndOfSummer|Beach}} [[Minigunner]] & [[Golden Minigunner]] ***Rank 5 - {{Color|EndOfSummer|Lifeguard}} [[Commander]] :In '''v1.3.1a''': *New [[Codes|code]]: beachglad2022 **Gives {{Color|Other|Beach}} [[Gladiator]] skin ==Changes & Bugfixes== *[[Tropical Isles]] remade. *[[Gladiator]] is now available through a gamepass for {{Robux|700}}. *[[Commander]] now returns to its original rotation after the ''Call to Arms'' ability ends. *Fixed [[Pyromancer]] and [[Golden Pyromancer]] not rotating correctly. *Fixed units having their range affected by [[Range Buff]]s and debuffs. *Fixed {{Color|Premium|Classic}} [[Shotgunner]] and {{Color|Premium|Cyber}} [[Medic]] skins being unobtainable from [[Premium Crate]]. *Fixed {{Color|Deluxe|Tycoon}} [[Farm]] and {{Color|Deluxe|Railgunner}} [[Ranger]] skins being unobtainable from [[Deluxe Crate]]. :In '''v1.3.1b''': *[[Gladiator]] gamepass taken offsale. ==Gallery== {{Gallery|Open = Yes| {{GalleryHeader|Thumbnails}} FZWG6bjXgAAK8 Y.jpg {{GalleryHeader|Icons}} ESummoner.jpg {{GalleryHeader|Promotional Images}} EndOfSummerPI.png BeachGladPI1.png BeachGladPI2.png }} ==Official Update Log== ''NOTE: Not everything here will be accurate as this is transcribed from the game's in-game update log. Several things may be incorrect and there may be things that are missing.'' ===v1.3.1=== {{UpdateLog| {{UpdateBanner|EndOfSummer.png|'End of Summer' Season}} {{UpdateH1|🌴 "Send Help!" - [[Tropical Isles]]}} {{UpdateWhiteText|Plan your summer's end with the new '[[End of Summer Season|End of Summer]]' season!
